title: Desktop first-run AI-account step stops "Looking for AI tools…" when the app cannot finish the scan (slow or failed login-shell read)
steps: S1: From packages/ui/tracy-onboard run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/scan.test.mjs test/flow.test.mjs test/mount.test.mjs
S2: Read the three named tests' ok/not ok lines.
expect: scanAgents keeps asking every REPOLL_MS while scanComplete is false for MAX_REPOLLS * REPOLL_MS >= SCAN_CAP_MS > 10 000 ms (the app's login-shell limit), then returns the last incomplete answer.

flow scanStopped turns an incomplete answer into a settled state: mode found (what was found so far) or popular with a count, note false, warn null; a complete answer and waiting are left as they are; rescan looks again.

Mounted plugin with a bridge that never completes: data-mode starts 'looking' with Refresh disabled; after the cap data-mode is 'found', no .tv-ob-spinner, Refresh enabled, no .tv-ob-note, no [data-warn], detect asked at least 8 times.
evidence: PR #1195 description: packaged 0.6.0-dev.1 on the iMac, SHELL = 6 s / 9 s zsh or /bin/tcsh stays Looking with Refresh disabled; fixed bundle settles at 11.1 s / 12.9 s
fence: SCAN_CAP_MS / MAX_REPOLLS in tracy-onboard scan.ts; scanStopped + Scan 'stopped' in flow.ts; the scan's then-branch in Onboard.tsx

tests: a scan that never completes is asked again until past the app
a scan the app never completes (slow or failed login-shell read)
